title: Nine Words in the Margin
subtitle: 评论与观点 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 评论与观点（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）
meta: 主题语境：评论与观点（社会服务与人际沟通·新闻与传媒）　|　核心词汇：comment　|　正文 336 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 comment 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1965 my teacher ① made a comment in the margin of my essay and said nothing else, and she said the making was the whole of the marking. The ② comment, meaning the sentence and not the mark, was nine words long and stayed there; comment, she said, is the only thing in a margin that is judged by how little it explains.

Every ③ comment in that margin had the same pencil, and the ④ comment at the end, meaning the one she wrote last and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever read twice. Comment, my mother said, is nine parts pencil and one part somebody willing to say little; my teacher said the saying little is the part that lasts.

My father meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ commenting on the news was the whole of the evening, meaning the opinion and not the pencil. The ⑥ comment, meaning the opinion and not any of that, is the only thing in an evening that everybody has and nobody asked for; comment, he said, is either something you write or the only word that means both a sentence and an opinion. She said the opinion is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ comment had become a line under a photograph, and the line had become an argument about who was allowed to write. The ⑧ comment of the whole thing, my teacher wrote in June, was one margin and forty years of saying little; comment, she said, is either the one at the end or the reason you learned to read twice. He said the reading was never mentioned.

The ⑨ comment I remember is the one at the end, which was written in 1979 and is still described as the shortest in the school. A ⑩ comment, my mother said in 1981, is the only thing that improves by being read twice; every comment, she said, is an opinion that has agreed to look like a sentence. She said the opinion was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 评论（指那一句评论本身，与那些分数相对）
C. 固定搭配：make a comment 发表评论
D. n. 评论（指那条页边空白处每一句）
E. n. 评论（指末尾那一句）
F. v. 发表意见；评论（comment on）
G. n. 意见；看法（抽象：那番被说出口的看法本身）
H. n. 议论；说法（抽象总称）

items.q: made a comment in the margin of my essay
The comment, meaning the sentence and not the mark
commenting on the news was the whole of the evening
the comment had become a line under a photograph
The comment of the whole thing
A comment, my mother said in 1981

answers.why: make a comment 意为“发表评论”，1965 年老师在我作文的页边写了一句话评论，别的什么也没说。
comment 意为“评论”，指那一句评论本身而不是那些分数，只有九个词长。
comment 指那条页边空白处每一句评论，每一句都是同一支铅笔写的。
comment 指末尾那一句（她最后写的那一句），是唯一有人读过两次的。
comment 作动词，comment on the news 意为“评论新闻”，父亲说评论新闻就是那个傍晚的全部。
comment 为抽象用法，指那番被说出口的看法本身，是傍晚里人人都有一份、却没人索要的东西。
comment 意为“评论”，到 1973 年这句评论成了照片下面的一行字。
comment 意为“议论、说法”，老师六月写道，整件事的说法是一条页边空白四十年的少言。
comment 意为“评论”，我记得的是末尾那一句，1979 年写下，至今仍被说成全校最短的。
comment 为抽象总称，母亲说一句评论是唯一会因为被读两次而变好的东西。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1965 年老师在我作文的页边写了一句话评论，别的什么也没说，她说写下才是这整个批改的全部。（make a comment）
那句评论，指的是那一句话而不是那些分数，只有九个词长，并且一直留在那儿。（comment）
那条页边空白处每一句评论都是同一支铅笔写的。（comment）
末尾那句评论，指的是她最后写的那一句，是唯一有人读过两次的。（comment）
父亲说评论新闻就是那个傍晚的全部，指的是那份看法而不是那支铅笔。（comment on）
1981 年母亲说，一句评论是唯一会因为被读两次而变好的东西。（comment）
answers: In 1965 my teacher made a comment in the margin of my essay and said nothing else, and she said the making was the whole of the marking.
The comment, meaning the sentence and not the mark, was nine words long and stayed there.
Every comment in that margin had the same pencil.
The comment at the end, meaning the one she wrote last and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever read twice.
My father said commenting on the news was the whole of the evening, meaning the opinion and not the pencil.
